gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-001 concerns unsupported RQMC convergence-rate claims and the absence of derivative-growth and corner-avoidance verification. It shares the general domain-transformation context but does not identify the gold defect that an ordinary joint CDF lacks the asserted vector inverse, or that a componentwise inverse has the wrong Jacobian for dependent proposals. None of ISSUE-002, ISSUE-003, or ISSUE-004 supplies that transport/CDF diagnosis either; they concern Fourier sign conventions and NIG martingale correction, respectively.
